input_contract.description: A token that must name a live PAID session, plus the requested transition. The token arrives with the app (from prontopc://run?token= or the await-payment poll) and is re-verified server-side.

output_contract.description: The authoritative session state, or a fail-closed refusal. A plan is recordable only in state created|diagnosed for a live paid session.
output_contract.refusal: 402 unpaid (unknown/expired token) | 409 conflict (concurrent state change) | 400 (bad request)

observation_contract.description: The session is the spine every other Orb hangs a run on: diagnostics/plan/consent/repair each act only within a live paid session, and the findings relay is keyed to the session id (a caller may read only the session it holds). The session never authors a plan or a repair - it only gates and records state.

evidence_contract.description: Session state lives in Firestore (paidSessions), keyed by token; a session exists ONLY post-verifyStripeSession, so a token that names a live session IS the proof of a paid (or 100%-off comped) run. Writes use optimistic concurrency (lastUpdateTime) so a delayed plan upload cannot overwrite a concurrent consent/state change.

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: Unknown/expired token -> 402 unpaid, no session created, no plan authored (fail-closed). Out-of-order or post-TTL transition -> refused; a concurrent write -> 409, the app re-reads the authoritative state.
